decision_summary: Enable a new external function in a protected execution profile.
key_assumptions: The function is restricted to the declared host and input types.

failure_modes.hypothesis: The function may reach resources outside its declared allowlist.
failure_modes.plausibility_basis: The adapter introduces a new network-capable code path.
failure_modes.material_consequence: Protected data or systems could be accessed.
failure_modes.discriminating_evidence: Review sandbox and allowlist tests under an independent security role.
failure_modes.cheapest_check: Run the isolated capability test suite.
failure_modes.result_summary: The allowlist and denial cases passed independent review.

residual_uncertainty: Production host differences require explicit human acceptance.
authority: This artifact records review evidence; it cannot grant execution authority.
